name: Documentation and project guidance
description: Explains the educational prototype, its architecture, operating constraints, setup, API surface, and contributor guidance.

name: Runtime and dependency configuration
description: Provides environment overrides and declares the backend test/runtime dependencies used by the application.

name: Backend persistence layer
description: Owns SQLite database location, connection lifecycle, schema creation, transaction/review storage, bulk inserts, and row conversion.

name: Synthetic data and anomaly-detection domain
description: Generates reproducible synthetic purchase behavior and trains, persists, calibrates, and applies the PyTorch VAE anomaly detector.

name: FastAPI application and HTTP API
description: Bootstraps the backend, initializes and seeds the demo, coordinates persistence and detection services, and exposes health, transaction, review, model, retraining, reset, analysis, and evaluation endpoints.

name: React dashboard and API integration
description: Implements the browser dashboard, navigation, transaction monitoring and review workflows, analysis lab, model views, styling, and the client wrapper for backend REST calls.

name: Development startup tooling
description: Provides platform-specific entry scripts that create or activate backend environments, install dependencies, and launch the FastAPI or Vite development servers.

name: Backend integration validation
description: Exercises the running FastAPI application through its lifecycle and representative health, overview, transaction, review, analysis, evaluation, model, and error paths.
